text: Welcome.
Allow yourself to pause here for a moment.
This time is for remembering your own reason for wanting to stop smoking.
Find a position where your body can rest.
You can let your eyes close, or keep them softly open.
Feel the support beneath your body.
Let your hands rest wherever they are comfortable.
Take a moment to notice your breathing.
You do not have to change it.
Thoughts may keep coming. You do not need to finish each one.
Notice the weight of your body resting against that support.
Let your attention stay with that feeling. There is nothing to work out for these next few moments.
Somewhere in you, something wanted this to be different.
What matters to you about making this change?
Let the reason be yours.
It may be something very ordinary. Time with someone you love. A morning that begins differently.
Let one of those moments come to mind.
Picture where you are, and what you are doing.
Notice what your hands are doing in that moment.
Notice one detail. The light, or something you can feel.
What matters to you in this picture?
Keep that reason close as the picture begins to soften.
Think of one small step that would support your decision today.
It could be reaching out to someone, or making time to work on your quit plan.
Begin to notice the room around you softly.
Feel the surface beneath you again.
When you are ready, you can gently open your eyes.
Welcome back.
Be gentle with yourself today.
